Enticing yet bizarre, it pulls the curious in like a whirlpool, drawing them to step inside.|Loading Tip — Porto-Veno Castle}} '''Porto-Veno Castle''' is an area located in {{Location|Thessaleo Fells|nocat=1}}. ==NPCs== {{NPCs by Location List|Porto-Veno Castle}} ==Trivia== *The castle's exterior is based on the Iberian [[wp:Manueline|Manueline]] architectural style, in contrast to the typical Ragunessi [[wp:Renaissance architecture|Italian Renaissance]] style. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Porto-Veno Castle |zhs = 波蒂维诺堡 |zht = 波蒂維諾堡 |ja = ポルトヴィーノ城 |ko = 포르티비노 성 |es = Castillo de Bottiveleno |fr = Fort Porto-Veno |de = Porto-Veno Burg |th = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}} ==Navigation== {{Location Navbox}} [[zh:波蒂维诺堡]]
